exercises.instruction: Tom can remember some things about his childhood, but he can’t remember others. Write sentences with He remembers … or He doesn’t remember … .

items.prompt: He was in hospital when he was a small child. He can still remember this.
answers: He remembers being in hospital when he was a small child.

items.prompt: He cried on his first day at school. He doesn’t remember this.
answers: He doesn’t remember crying on his first day at school.

items.prompt: Once he fell into the river. He remembers this.
answers: He remembers falling into the river.

items.prompt: He said he wanted to be a doctor. He doesn’t remember this.
answers: He doesn’t remember saying he wanted to be a doctor.
He doesn’t remember wanting to be a doctor.

items.prompt: Once he was bitten by a dog. He doesn’t remember this.
answers: He doesn’t remember being bitten by a dog.

items.prompt: His sister was born when he was four. He remembers this.
answers: He remembers his sister being born (when he was four).
